CustomField.description: This advisor's share of the trade's Signed Amount, calculated by TradeAllocator at load. Negative for redemptions, so summing by advisor and fund gives cumulative net sales (the team's AUM). Allocations for a trade always sum exactly to the Signed Amount.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The advisor's share of this trade. Redemptions appear as negative amounts.
CustomField.label: Allocated Amount
